source_summary: Bundled FIRST-VERSION seed (ADR 0027): 3 real, currently-public botnet C2 IPs from abuse.ch Feodo Tracker (a redistribution-friendly public feed this repo already fetches live in modules/hydra/hydra-feed-fetch.sh) + 4 HookProbe-owned canary/test indicators (RFC 5737/2606 reserved values + the public EICAR test-file hash) that prove every indicator TYPE parses and matches without needing, or shipping, a live real-malware sample. NOT a full MISP/OTX/TAXII feed — see security/threat-intel/README.md for the honest scope.

indicators.note: reported offline by the source feed as of the snapshot date; kept as a lower-priority historical indicator, not dropped.
RFC 5737 TEST-NET-3 — guaranteed never a real internet host. Proves the IP matcher fires end-to-end without shipping a live indicator.
RFC 2606 .invalid TLD — guaranteed never to resolve. Proves the domain matcher (SNI/HTTP-Host) fires without shipping a live indicator.

The same public EICAR test string modules/yara-scan/rules/eicar_test_string.yar already ships, by its sha256. Proves the hash matcher's SHAPE and parsing; NOT currently wired to a live host-telemetry event (see the crate's honest-limits doc — hookprobe-evidence's `files` table carries no hash column yet).

A synthetic 32-hex canary value in the real JA3 (MD5) shape — NOT a captured real-malware fingerprint. Proves the ja3 matcher fires against the Application pivot's ja3 field without a fabricated 'real' sample being claimed as such.

A canary in valid FoxIO JA4 TLS-CLIENT shape (t<ver><sni><nc><ne><alpn>_<ciphers>_<exts+sigalgs>) — this is the repo's own JA4 golden reference vector (dpi.rs `ja4_client_matches_the_foxio_reference_algorithm`), NOT a captured real-malware fingerprint. It is the SAME value napse_loader::dpi computes for the reference ClientHello, so it proves the ja4 matcher fires end-to-end against the Application pivot's ja4 field. Real modern-C2 JA4 fingerprints are fetched live by modules/hydra/hydra-feed-fetch.sh; this seed ships only the honest canary.

A canary in valid FoxIO JA4S TLS-SERVER shape (t<ver><ne><alpn>_<cipher>_<exts>) — the repo's JA4S golden reference vector (dpi.rs `ja4s_matches_the_foxio_reference_algorithm_and_keeps_grease`), NOT a captured real-malware fingerprint. Proves the ja4s matcher fires against the ServerHello-derived ja4s field. JA4H is deliberately NOT shipped as a threat-intel type (see crates/hookprobe-hydra/src/feed.rs — HTTP-client fingerprints are too high false-positive for IOC matching).
